name: Healing Speed
teaser: A lightweight QoL mod that lets you configure healing and surgery use speed without changing game balance.
description_html:
Healing Speed

A lightweight and configurable medical QoL mod for SPT 4.0.13.

Healing Speed gives you control over treatment speed, medical animations and healing delays while preserving EFT’s original health, wound and resource mechanics.

Features

  • Independent speed control for medkits:
    • AI-2
    • Car First Aid Kit
    • Salewa
    • IFAK
    • AFAK
    • Grizzly
    • Compatible modded medkits
  • Independent surgery speed for CMS, Surv12 and compatible modded surgery kits.
  • Independent treatment speed for regular, aluminum, Tigzresq and compatible fracture splints.
  • Additional speed multiplier for treating light and heavy bleeding.
  • Configurable medical animation speed.
  • Configurable delay before treatment begins.
  • Continuous Healing across multiple body parts.
  • Continuous CMS/Surv12 surgery and reusable-splint treatment.
  • Optional removal of the vanilla HP-per-use limit.
  • Optional protection of the final charge or resource point.
  • Advanced support for medical items added by other mods.
  • Full configuration through the F12 Configuration Manager.
  • Client-side only - no server mod or profile conversion required.
  • Open source under the MIT license.

Default Configuration

Setting Default
HealingSpeedMultiplier 1.0
BleedingTreatmentSpeedMultiplier 2.0
SurgerySpeedMultiplier 3.0
SplintSpeedMultiplier 1.0
StartDelayMultiplier 0.5
AnimationSpeedMultiplier 1.5
Continuous Healing Enabled
Continuous Healing Transition Delay 0.5 seconds
Remove HP Per Use Limit Enabled
Keep Last Use Disabled

1.0 represents vanilla speed. 2.0 is twice as fast, while 0.5 is twice as slow.

Continuous Healing

When enabled, the same medical item automatically continues to the next applicable body part.

Treatment continues until:

  • There are no applicable injuries remaining.
  • The medical item runs out of usable resources.
  • Keep Last Use reaches the protected final charge.
  • The item is removed.
  • The player manually cancels the action.

Healing Speed uses EFT’s native health controller to select the next body part, preserving vanilla treatment priority and cancellation behavior.

The transition between body parts can be configured separately. By default, the maximum transition delay is approximately 0.5 seconds.

Bleeding Treatment

BleedingTreatmentSpeedMultiplier is applied only when the current medical item can remove an active light or heavy bleeding effect.

The default value is 2.0, making compatible bleeding treatment twice as fast.

This multiplier stacks with HealingSpeedMultiplier, but does not modify bleeding effects, wound costs or medical item resource consumption.

Remove HP Per Use Limit

Vanilla medkits have a maximum amount of HP they can restore during one application. For example, an AI-2 normally restores no more than 50 HP per use.

When Remove HP Per Use Limit is enabled, one application can continue until:

  • The selected body part is fully healed; or
  • The medkit runs out of resources.

This does not create free HP. Every restored HP point is still deducted from the medical item’s real resource.

Keep Last Use

When enabled, Keep Last Use preserves exactly one resource point or charge in supported reusable medical items.

This is useful for valuable medkits, surgery kits and reusable splints that the player may want to keep instead of consuming completely.

Disable the option through F12 when you deliberately want to use the final charge.

Modded Medical Items

Template IDs for medical items added by other mods can be configured in:

BepInEx/config/HealingSpeed/item-ids.json

The file is created automatically after the first launch.

{
  "healingItemIds": [],
  "surgeryItemIds": [],
  "splintItemIds": []
}

Add the template ID to the appropriate list and restart the game.

Item IDs are intentionally stored outside the F12 menu to keep advanced configuration separate from normal user settings.

Installation

  1. Download the release ZIP.
  2. Extract the BepInEx folder into your SPT installation directory.
  3. Confirm that the DLL is located at:
BepInEx/plugins/HealingSpeed/moon11yy.HealingSpeed.dll
  1. Start SPT.
  2. Press F12 to configure the mod.

Compatibility

  • SPT 4.0.13
  • EFT client build 40087
  • Client-side only
  • Compatible with existing profiles
  • No profile conversion required

What’s New in Healing Speed 1.4.6

Fixed

  • Removed the unnecessary 1–2 second delay between body-part treatments during Continuous Healing.
  • Medical effects now finish as soon as the current body part receives all required HP.
  • Continuous Healing proceeds to the next body part smoothly, using the configured transition delay.

Preserved

  • Original HP regeneration rate and medical resource consumption.
  • 2x bleeding treatment speed introduced in version 1.4.5.
  • Vanilla fracture treatment and CMS/Surv12 surgery behavior.
  • Vanilla cancellation, wound removal and item consumption rules.

Design Goals

  • Small and focused QoL functionality.
  • Clean Harmony patches with minimal compatibility impact.
  • Vanilla-friendly health and wound mechanics.
  • No profile modifications.
  • No automatic cancellation hacks.
  • Open-source and easy to audit.

Designed for SPT 4.0.13.
